irregularities.summary: Cold-cache RuntimeError when h83_phys_rm.f16.npy is absent.
irregularities.resolution: Implemented full 72-channel cold-cache builder in src/gems84/features.py using column-major (72, 5167373) write followed by 500k-row block transpose.

irregularities.summary: CSV column header mismatch (utm_e,utm_n,gt_quartz_c,... vs actual row,col,utm_x,utm_y,temp_c,geothermquartz_c,geothermchalc_c,geothermcat_c in gdr_wellspring_in_footprint.csv and row,col in gdr_volcanic_vents_in_footprint.csv) causing silent all-zero channels on cold build.
irregularities.resolution: Fixed in src/gems84/features.py:_rasterize_geothermal_thm_and_vents; added paleo-sinter (709 px) and 2m temperature probe (3,800 px) layers; verified 0 zero-variance columns across all 96 channels.

irregularities.component: Archived A5 holdout emission with full-catalogue registry halos
irregularities.summary: The archived production-like holdout emitter used registry halos derived from the full catalogue, including withheld faults; a single-feature canary does not test this side channel.
irregularities.resolution: The prior A5 HOLDOUT-DTI is archived, not certified fold-clean and not used as a current score. The holdout emitter now omits registry halos; no replacement score has been run. Recompute using buffered whole-segment folds and visible-only catalogue features.

irregularities.component: DrivenData portal range validator ('Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]')
irregularities.summary: NaN outside active footprint or numeric GDAL nodata metadata triggers portal range rejection.
irregularities.resolution: Enforced via vendor/gems57/submission_writer.py and validate.py: 0 NaNs across all 12,279,160 pixels, nodata=None, values strictly in {0.0, 1.0}, all_checks_passed=True.

irregularities.component: Competition labels.tif vs existing_faults.tif vs sample_submission.tif
irregularities.summary: labels.tif and existing_faults.tif are byte-identical (60,988 positive pixels), and sample_submission.tif contains 1.0 on those 60,988 pixels rather than total fault absence.
irregularities.resolution: Audited in evidence/grid_audit.json; all 60,988 catalogue pixels are explicitly masked (cat_overlap = 0).

irregularities.summary: 1m USGS 3DEP LiDAR coverage is absent across 24.60% (1,271,174 / 5,167,373 pixels) of the active footprint.
irregularities.resolution: Bridged in H84-B by fusing 1m LiDAR with 100%-coverage 10m 3DEP sub-100m profile curvature (topo_10m_derived_100m_u8.tif) and fluvial chi-disequilibrium (dem10_chi_100m_i16.tif).

irregularities.component: Shared literal registry comparator and SHA-pinned 17GEMSDOE witness
irregularities.summary: Earlier 359-raster cap truncated/exempted dense prior support and failed to enforce the literal any-raster forward-overlap rule.
irregularities.resolution: The archived H84 dots have 1.0 forward 3-pixel overlap with the SHA-pinned witness (limit 0.70). A single counterexample proves failure, not copying. The shared saturation certificate shows every nonempty prediction under the current support rule would fail. NEGATIVE — DO NOT SUBMIT; see registry/release_status.json.

irregularities.summary: Stale/incorrect competition URL used competition ID 311, and repository materials labelled user-supplied GEMSDOE family scores and benchmark values ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED without archived submission-page receipts. The two stored leaderboard snapshots also disagree on the participant associated with 0.4413.
irregularities.resolution: Corrected official competition URL pointers to competition 306; downgraded scores to OWNER-REPORTED where no submission receipt is present; documented the snapshot inconsistency and current-review network limitation. Do not treat the 0.2778/0.3195/0.4413 values as verified current scores.
